scope: Joint paired finite bilinear risk, exact synthetic witnesses and product-proxy relative metric bound; structural retrieval only, no global solver/model/GPU/e2e claim

implementation.acceptance: Independent implementation matches stated finite exact scope

reference_boundary.procedure: Fraction direct risk versus independently constructed moment; rank and proxy counterexamples
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact equality and discriminating counterexamples, η<1 boundary explicit

data_integrity.procedure: All exact inputs/probabilities/IDs/current hashes and corpus closure
data_integrity.acceptance: Unique cases, no missing or nonfinite raw; unchanged holdout metadata

numerical_sanity.procedure: Exact fractions/units/known diagonal spectra, no empirical covariance certificate
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Actual scoped exact outputs, scalar values finite; no float/generic eigensolver claim

measurement_validity.procedure: Diagnostic time/chars only; no performance/model test
measurement_validity.acceptance: No performance claim; N/A with reason

reproducibility.procedure: Fresh separate direct recomputation without overwriting raw
reproducibility.acceptance: Same scoped risk/formulas/hits; timestamps excluded from correctness
